/* a comment */ :root { --main: #1f2937; } body, .card:hover > a::before { color: #abcdef; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); width: calc(100% - 1.5em); margin: 0 auto; padding: 10px 2rem; font-family: "Helvetica Neue", 'Arial', sans-serif; background-image: url(images/bg.png); -webkit-transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out; } @media (min-width: 768px) and (orientation: landscape) { .card { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } } @keyframes spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } input[type="text"] { border-color: red; }
